name: Amino acid metabolism with tyrosine and proline catabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid metabolic or catabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine members separate it from C1, C3 and C4, and proline/glycine/glyoxylate members from C2.

name: Transcriptional and negative regulation of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern transcriptional programmes and regulators of myeloid progenitor differentiation; negative regulation of granulocyte/monocyte/macrophage differentiation separates it from C1 and C3, and RUNX1/progenitor proliferation/transcription from C2 and C4.

name: Chondrocyte development, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern chondrocyte development or cartilage/joint formation; joint morphogenesis separates it from C1 and C4, and cartilage condensation/morphogenesis from C2 and C3, which instead add articular cartilage, homeostasis or ossification.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic clearance
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and clearance controlling muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern release of sequestered calcium, its removal from the cytosol and the resulting control of cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation; confusables instead emphasise SERCA import and positive inotropy/chronotropy.

qualifier: melanin synthesis, pigment granules and light response
name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: All members concern MITF-M-regulated melanocyte biology and pigmentation; melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and UV-A/blue light response separate it from C1 and C3, and melanin biosynthesis/pigment granule localization from C2 and C4, which carry MITF cell-cycle and DNA-repair arms.

name: Cardiomyocyte growth and adaptation with enhanced heart contraction
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and regeneration plus positive control of heart rate and contraction force; the contraction members separate it from C4 (calcineurin/NFAT), and striated/cardiac focus from smooth-muscle C1-C3.

name: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern stimulatory cAMP production (GPCR, forskolin) and PKA activation; C1 is inhibitory adenylate cyclase signalling and C2-C4 add CREB, PDE and cAMP catabolism.

name: Ovarian cycle from oocyte maturation to luteolysis
rationale: All members are stages of the ovarian/estrous cycle (follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis); confusables instead add gonadotropin hormone responses and secretion.

name: Iminoglycinuria from defective glycine and proline transporters
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 transporter defects causing hyperglycinuria and iminoglycinuria; confusables cover other aminoacidurias, hexose and urate transport.

qualifier: membrane protein insertion and COPII anterograde export
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII anterograde export
rationale: Members concern SRP/tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER and COPII-mediated ER-to-Golgi export; multi-pass insertion and connexin oligomerization separate it from C2/C4 (COPI, folding, ERAD), and COPII export from C1/C3.

name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic head/face/palate or limb morphogenesis (with mesenchymal development); limbs separate it from C1/C3/C4 (pharyngeal glands, ear), palate/neurocranium from C2 (ossification, sutures).

core: CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production
name: CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production with cGAS–STING sensing
rationale: Members concern chemokine (CCL5) and dendritic cell cytokine production; cGAMP import and cGAS–STING regulation separate it from C2/C3, and the cytokine/chemokine output from C1 (interferon/TREX1) and C4 (TLR7-9).

name: Centrosome positioning and spindle orientation in asymmetric division
rationale: Members concern microtubule organising centre nucleation/anchoring, centrosome localisation and spindle orientation; spindle/astral/asymmetric division members separate it from C1/C4, centriole cohesion and anchoring from C2, cortex/actin links from C3.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER–Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: All members concern COPI-coated vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER/Golgi vesicle targeting; C1/C3 are COPII export, C4 vesicle tethering, C2 ER targeting.

name: Endocytic recycling and post-Golgi delivery to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport; post-Golgi delivery/cholesterol traffic separate it from C3/C4 (constitutive secretion, Golgi localisation), recycling from C2 (retrograde to Golgi/ER).

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis and inherited retinoid disorders
name: Retinoid metabolism to retinoic acid, including inherited retinoid disorders
rationale: All members concern vitamin A/retinoid metabolism; retinoid disease members (STRA6) separate it from C1/C2/C4 (retinoic acid response, CYP26, vitamin D), and retinoic acid synthesis from C3 (visual retinoid cycle).

name: Solute carrier transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated plasma membrane transport of amino acids, oligopeptides, urate and organic anions and their inherited defects; neutral amino acid/peptide transport separates it from C1/C4 (organic cations) and C3 (hexoses), urate/anions and neutral amino acids from C2 (cationic amino acids).

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and inhibition of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members concern restraint of myoblast differentiation/muscle development, satellite cell maintenance and atrophy after inactivity; atrophy/inactivity separate it from pro-myogenic C2, and negative myoblast regulation from C3/C4 (hypertrophy, calcineurin).

qualifier: glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose absorption
name: Glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose absorption, with inherited defects
rationale: Members concern glycogen synthesis/breakdown and glycogen storage diseases plus carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport; glycogen members separate it from C1/C2 (galactose, urate), absorption members from C3/C4 (glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, fructose).

qualifier: Wnt and RUNX2 control from mesenchymal progenitors
name: Wnt- and RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation via Wnt, RUNX2 and BMP; RUNX2 regulation, Wnt antagonists and osteocyte mechanosignalling separate it from confusables focused on osteoclasts, mineralisation, collagen or cartilage.

name: M-CSF signaling in macrophage proliferation and osteoclastogenesis
rationale: Members concern M-CSF/interleukin receptor signalling, macrophage proliferation/fusion and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption; osteoclast/bone members separate it from C1/C3 (monocyte/DC differentiation), M-CSF/interleukin members from C2/C4 (DAP12).

name: Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure (ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly, positioning), vesicle budding and membrane tubulation; tubulation separates it from C1 (COPI traffic), Golgi ribbon dynamics from C2/C4.

qualifier: focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix in fibroblast migration
name: Focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly in fibroblast migration
rationale: Members concern integrin/fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly with cytoskeletal remodelling and fibroblast migration; focal adhesion/collagen-TGFB members separate it from C1/C3/C4 (syndecan, stress fibres), fibronectin/integrin from C2 (EMT, CCN).

name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern constitutive secretion, Golgi membrane localisation and endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling; recycling/endosome organisation separates it from C1/C3/C4 (Golgi–endosome–lysosome retrograde traffic) and C2 (Rab/ARF signalling).

name: Adenylate cyclase regulation by inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase, mainly inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic signalling; adenylate cyclase regulation separates it from C1/C2 (adrenergic secretion effects), inhibition from C3 (PKA activation), adrenergic receptors from C4 (muscarinic, purinergic).

qualifier: break-induced replication and mitotic recombination resolution
name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere capping and recombination-based maintenance (D-loop, t-circle), break-induced replication and resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates; BIR/unwinding separate it from C1, mitotic resolution/checkpoint from C2-C4.

qualifier: linkage-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain assembly, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin activation, linkage-specific chain formation, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly/degradation; DUB and chain-type members separate it from C2/C4 (ERAD, autophagy, quality control), proteasome/TRiC members from C1/C3 (neddylation, COP9).

name: Kidney development with nephron formation and tubule segmentation
rationale: All members concern kidney/nephric duct development; metanephric nephron formation, tubule segments and mesenchymal-epithelial transition separate it from confusables centred on ureteric bud formation, organ induction and kidney size.

name: Bilirubin formation, hepatic uptake, conjugation and excretion
rationale: Members concern heme degradation to bilirubin, OATP hepatic uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export and their hyperbilirubinemias; heme/bilirubin members separate it from drug ADME confusables.

qualifier: bidirectional NK and T cell cytotoxicity control
name: Positive and negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK cell signatures, activation, degranulation and cytotoxicity plus T cell cytotoxicity regulation and MHC class Ib presentation; negative regulation and MHC Ib separate it from C1/C2, positive T cell cytotoxicity and receptor activation from C3/C4.
